A 26.4B parameter model running locally on a 32GB Mac just hit 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

Here are the key technical developments from today across model releases, voice API pricing, and infrastructure.

💻 Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer featuring 3.4B active parameters. The model scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified and runs on a standard 32GB Mac or a single DGX Spark.

🎙️ OpenAI launched GPT-Live-1.1 in their API for voice agents. The full-duplex model improves multilingual accents and transcription while adding a standby mode that bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute, down from $0.05.

📈 Anthropic officially went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday, transitioning the Claude AI research lab into a publicly traded company.

⚡ Data center energy estimates project that 87% of Anthropic's power will come from gas and 11% from coal by 2028.

🛡️ OpenRouter published an announcement detailing data processing incidents occurring across third-party inference providers on its network.

The combination of lower voice API idle costs and high-performing local coding models offers practical efficiency gains for software engineering teams.
